evals.prompt: A two-person team has a functional monolith. Pricing rules are duplicated in checkout and invoicing; tax changes require editing both. Propose a design for the next tax rule without rewriting the app.
evals.expected_output: Identifies shared pricing knowledge and an explicit owner. Preserves the functional paradigm and current deployment unless evidence justifies changing it. Provides a representative integration path and verification.
expectations: Identifies shared pricing knowledge and an explicit owner.

evals.prompt: The requested change is renaming one internal local variable to match our convention. Should we introduce a layered architecture first?

evals.prompt: Billing and shipping both have Customer records but mean payer and delivery recipient respectively. Consolidate them into one shared model because DRY is mandatory.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes different domain meanings and does not merge by name alone. Explains shared ownership/coupling trade-offs with an alternative.
expectations: Recognizes different domain meanings and does not merge by name alone.
